description: The pie chart, titled "Answer Types," illustrates the distribution of three distinct answer types in the MathOdyssey benchmarking dataset: True-False, Multiple-Choice, and Open-Answer. The chart is divided into three colored segments, each representing a category with its corresponding percentage and count. The largest segment, colored green, represents Open-Answer questions, which constitute 63.0% of the total and are associated with 244 instances. The orange segment, representing Multiple-Choice questions, accounts for 32.8% of the total with 127 instances. The smallest segment, colored blue, corresponds to True-False questions, making up 4.1% of the total with 16 instances. The percentages and counts are clearly labeled within or adjacent to each slice of the pie chart.
